notes: Removed 'la gon' (goodbye) as unverifiable. Constructed-language parent 'languages' now holds only real conlangs (fiction removed). Romanized Japanese/Chinese/Korean/Greek greetings kept plain (arigato, ni hao, efharisto) as English references usually write them. Phonetic alphabet words all capitalized as code words (Alfa, X-ray). Considered but did not mark separate: greek letters, keyboard symbols, typography words (some deep members like widow/bowl/counter only make sense in typography). Hello/thank you/goodbye kept non-separate under 'foreign words'; did not add English g'day for that reason.
